mapper.select: SELECT w.wallet_id, w.tenant_id, w.balance_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE l.direction WHEN 'IN' THEN l.amount ELSE -l.amount END), 0) AS ledger_net FROM dcs_tenant_wallet w LEFT JOIN dcs_tenant_wallet_ledger l ON l.wallet_id = w.wallet_id AND l.del_flag = '0' WHERE w.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY w.wallet_id, w.tenant_id, w.balance_amount

SELECT ledger_id, wallet_id, tenant_id, balance_before, prev_after FROM ( SELECT ledger_id, wallet_id, tenant_id, balance_before, LAG(balance_after) OVER (PARTITION BY wallet_id ORDER BY ledger_id) AS prev_after FROM dcs_tenant_wallet_ledger WHERE del_flag = '0' ) t WHERE prev_after IS NOT NULL AND balance_before <> prev_after
SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS null_biz_count FROM dcs_tenant_wallet_ledger WHERE del_flag = '0' AND biz_type = 'DEDUCT' AND biz_id IS NULL GROUP BY tenant_id

SELECT u.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS usage_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE u.wallet_ledger_id IS NULL AND COALESCE(u.pricing_snapshot, '') NOT LIKE '%"walletDeducted":false%' AND ROUND(u.cost_amount, 4) > 0) AS deduct_missing, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE u.wallet_ledger_id IS NULL AND u.pricing_snapshot LIKE '%"reason":"currency:%') AS non_cny_exempt, COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(u.cost_amount, 4)) FILTER (WHERE u.wallet_ledger_id IS NOT NULL), 0) AS usage_sum, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.amount) FROM dcs_tenant_wallet_ledger l WHERE l.del_flag = '0' AND l.service_code = 'AI_ASSISTANT_CHAT' AND l.tenant_id = u.tenant_id), 0) AS ledger_sum FROM dcs_ai_usage u WHERE u.caller = 'ASSISTANT_CHAT' AND u.success = '1' GROUP BY u.tenant_id
